description: This file defines the 'Operand' interface used within the OpenMRS logic API, serving as a marker interface for any object that can be operated on within logical expressions, particularly in conjunction with operators such as ComparisonOperator.

classes.name: Operand
classes.description: A marker interface representing entities that can be operated on in logical expressions within the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if this Operand supports a specific ComparisonOperator.
